title: Align validation docs and CI gates for browser coverage
description:
Problem: validation guidance can imply stronger coverage than what CI enforces, which reduces trust in delivery safety.

Desired outcome: synchronize README and quality-runbook documentation with actual required CI checks, including browser regression gates and artifact expectations.

Scope:
- In scope: README validation sections, testing runbook references, and explicit mandatory/optional gate annotations.
- Out of scope: non-testing documentation cleanup unrelated to validation and CI.

Dependencies:
- CI topology finalization from TSK-0069.

Acceptance criteria:
- Documentation clearly distinguishes required PR gates from optional local checks.
- Browser regression gate commands and artifact paths are documented and current.
- Sprint/audit links remain traceable from docs to task records.

Validation:
- Doc review against live CI workflow definitions and sample run outputs.

Rollback:
- Revert doc changes if workflow naming changes unexpectedly; reissue once CI contract stabilizes.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from audit finding F-005 to reduce documentation-to-gate drift.
